description: Our bill simply asks insurance companies to ensure that they are not discriminating against people of color and other underserved groups. Coloradans shouldn’t be charged more for insurance of any kind based on their skin color, ethnicity, educational background, or ZIP code.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Naquetta Ricks for Colorado
title: Our legislation aims to bring accountability and transparency to the insurance industry — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
